system: ICT desk A-setups (H1 iFVG reversal) split by what the sweep took: a pool of relative equal lows / highs vs a single low / high. Lab engine api/_ictlab.js runMarket (the desk's signals / isASetup / sizeOf / simulate) on OANDA mid H1: NAS100, SPX500, US30, US2000, XAU
preregistered: PREREGISTRATION.md (committed and pushed before the full stage ran)

definition.text: the sweep candle trades through two or more confirmed, untouched H1 swing lows (3 candles each side, last 96 H1 candles, at least 4 candles apart) whose lows are within 0.1 x the daily ATR(14) of each other; sells mirror

costs: lab COST round trip: NQ 1.5, ES 0.5, YM 3, RTY 0.4 points, gold 0.5; net R = size x (R - cost / risk); live sizing (sizeOf)
multipleTesting: Holm over the 3 pre-registered tests (one-sided Welch, equal-pool stream vs the other A-setups, out of sample, normal approximation)
verdict: FAIL. None of the 3 pre-registered tests passes (1 inconclusive: T3 gold); the A-rule stays as it is
